meaning: Independent finite semantic controls for standalone typed Rules, over structural facts without factory ownership or implicit invariant execution.
oracle: Interpret checked Rule expressions and ontology property selectors independently. Preserve exact UInt64, raw String identity and ordering, Boolean outcomes, Entity identity equality, Value Object full-value equality, sum tags/payloads, optional absence, ordered list occurrences, canonical sets, set images and first-representative list-to-set conversion. No generated source is used as the expression oracle.
inputs: Generate structurally valid facts from every declared parameter and recursively referenced type; do not filter facts through factory base or extension Rules. All formal parameters are required. Optional data fields may be absent and normalize to null. Malformed closed data objects, accessors, hidden/symbol/extra fields, sparse or nonplain arrays, missing values, invalid sum tags/payloads, duplicate set elements and invalid exact integers raise TypeError RULE_INPUT without coercing or mutating caller data.
cases: Use source literal and boundary seeds, complete diagonal vectors and independent field/parameter variations, equal and different values, all declared sum variants, collection permutations/duplicates and Entity state variations sharing identity. Retain false as a legitimate Rule result, not a failed verification. Compare exact Boolean results or RULE_INPUT errors and descriptor-only no-getter/no-mutation observations. Valid frozen/null-prototype data must remain supported.
bounds: At most 4096 expanded recipes or cases per Rule, 65536 project cases and 8 MiB serialized controls. Reference evaluation retains 65536 visits and depth 64. Capacity exhaustion keeps the entire Rule not_evaluable, with every source node retained; no partial passing Rule or universal proof claim.
execution: Run only checked pure Rule modules and their exact native dependency closure inside the existing private permission-restricted observer. No factories, Operations, Workflows, provider calls or output-target writes.
compatibility: Add one source pin preserving all 47 predecessors. Do not change Rule v8, factory v12, equality/ordering policy, SFOL, AlchLang, public defaults or production authority.
